description: Human IV clearance and Vss for the v2 benchmark drugs (P33.1 stage 2), from ChEMBL-curated Lombardo/Obach human IV PK compilations and the AstraZeneca ChEMBL DMPK dataset. therapeutic_cmax is null throughout. Schulz M. et al. 2020 Crit Care (PMID 32375836, PMC7201985, doi:10.1186/s13054-020-02915-5) was verified and its supplementary table (Additional file 1, a PDF of therapeutic/toxic/comatose-fatal blood-plasma concentrations for 1100+ substances) was downloaded. It was not used: the table's numeric cells have reference footnote digits fused directly onto the value with no delimiter, for example 0.9-3.9308 for abacavir, which is the range 0.9 to 3.9 plus footnote 308, not the number 3.9308. Splitting value from footnote by rule is exactly the regex-a-number-out-of-prose risk this project forbids, so no value was extracted rather than risk a silently wrong one.
